content.title: Why MP Materials (MP) Is Down 7.1% After Wider Q3 Losses and Profitability Guidance Shift
content.summary: MP Materials reported third-quarter 2025 financial results, revealing sales of US$53.55 million and a net loss of US$41.78 million, with rare earth oxide (REO) production slightly lower year-over-year but higher neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) output. Despite wider quarterly losses, company management announced an expectation to return to profitability in the fourth quarter of 2025 and beyond, signaling an important shift in their outlook. content.title: MP Materials Earnings Are in Focus as Rare-Earth Rally Fades
content.summary: The past month has been wild for  MP Materials  and other rare-earth stocks.  Coming into Thursday trading, shares of MP Materials, the largest rare- earth producer in the Western Hemisphere, and aspiring rare earth miners  Ramaco  Resource and  USA Rare Earth  s were down an average of 34% over the past month.  MP stock, however, was up a solid 3.3% in premarket trading on Thursday, only to close down 5.4% at $51.95.
